about: What the office-hours scene's ending (src/director/data/purpose-arcs.json, constituent-help) decides on the constituent's case (constituent-cases.ts handleCase): a call made or a caseworker given is the office taking the case up, which refers it as helping does; a no is the case turned away. Any other ending leaves the case to the office's own call by its deadline. Names only; nothing here is a number the world runs on.
